text_block_list.text:
Rumor has it that paparazzi have been appearing lately, targeting
students on their days off. I received a notice from the academy
asking trainers to warn their students as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Good afternoon. Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Kris and I are going to ponder
why water tastes so exceptionally good
after finishing a whole bowl of ramen!
Just to be safe, I decided to mention the rumors about those paparazzi to the two of them—and their accompanying bodyguard.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Is that so... Oh dear, that is troublesome.
Setting myself aside, if it inconveniences the shop—"

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
Your Highness, fear not.
We shall see to it that such insolent scoundrels do not step foot inside the establishment.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Oh, thank you as always. Well then, since we're all ready—let's head out together, everyone♪"
Having just received the announcement from the academy, I decided to accompany them for now—and we all headed to the ramen shop together.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Phew... We finally got in. As expected of a popular shop,
that massive line totally surprised me!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“—Are you alright? We ended up—seated apart
from the Bodyguard.”

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"It can't be helped with it being this crowded.
Besides, with those girls, they're close enough
to rush over in an instant if anything happens."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Now then! More importantly, right now let's enjoy some golden broth salt ramen topped with seared chashu♪

text_block_list.name: Store Clerk?
text_block_list.text:
—Heh, looks like they managed to get away from their SP.
Kukuku, they'd never suspect that a paparazzi
has slipped in disguised as a waiter.

text_block_list.name: Paparazzo
text_block_list.text: This towel wrapped around my head... At first glance, it looks like your typical popular ramen shop clerk, but there is actually a hidden camera embedded in it.

text_block_list.name: Paparazzo
text_block_list.text:
You can't escape my undercover photography lens.
Now then, Lady Fine Motion, I'll snap away, snap and snap—

text_block_list.name: Paparazzo
text_block_list.text: ...Wh-!? Wh-What the!? Who is that person sitting next to me radiating an aura that definitely doesn't belong to a student...!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Delicious.

text_block_list.name: Paparazzo
text_block_list.text:
—English?! Don't tell me... Is he Secret Police too?!
To think he'd disguise himself as a student... But if I give up now, my ramen training will have all been for nothing—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Mmh. —Excuse me.
I would like to —request that.

text_block_list.name: Paparazzo
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, ma'am...! What can I do for you?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —It is a confession.

text_block_list.name: Paparazzo
text_block_list.text: —A confession!? Y-You're telling me you saw through everything!? A-Are you saying her eyes... can surpass my undercover paparazzi lens... !?

text_block_list.name: Paparazzo
text_block_list.text:
GRAAAH, I won't accept this! 40 years as a paparazzi!
To have my work ruined by a mere brat like—

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text: What?! Are you—a paparazzi?!

text_block_list.name: Paparazzo
text_block_list.text: Ngh!? D-Damn ittt...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...What's going on...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
What a surprise!
Looks like there was paparazzi inside the shop.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, Kris, that's not 'repentance,'
it's called a 'Chinese milk vetch'.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Mmhââa mistake.

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, thanks to Kris S-san,
we were able to catch the paparazzi.
We are very grateful.”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...?
What... does this mean?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufufu—anyway, it means you did a great job♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Why—did it turn out like this?
choice_data_list: It was because you looked so strangely unfazed...
Because you looked as strong as a real bodyguard.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hmm, true. While slurping those noodles, Kris... well, maybe not a secret agent, but she certainly had the air of a battle-hardened gourmet.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...I was only thinking
that... the ramen is delicious, though.

And so, the paparazzi commotion targeting Tracen Academy's
students was resolved, thanks to the valiant efforts (?)
of Symboli Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... This presence. This overwhelming aura
that wards off any wrongdoers just by existing—"

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
“—How about it? If your career path after graduation
isn't decided yet, why not the path of an SP—”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...No.
I have—a mission."

And so, the paparazzi commotion targeting Tracen Academy's
students was resolved, thanks to the valiant efforts (?)
of Symboli Kris S.
